findings.current: No—it had to be able to.
findings.defect: Reverses the hope that the Myriad-Poison Ring will counter Blood Soul Gu.
findings.rationale: The preceding sentence says the gu cannot escape the ring’s power; 반드시 그래야 한다 insists that this must be true.

findings.current:
The middle-aged shopkeeper stared at his customer, looking as if he couldn’t be bothered. Irritation dripped from his curt words.

The customer parted his lips.
findings.defect: Reverses who is watching whom and attributes curt words to the employee before he speaks again.
findings.rationale: The customer watches the employee before speaking; the employee’s expression and manner convey his impatience.
findings.replacement: The middle-aged employee looked bored to death, his manner dripping with brusqueness. The customer studied him for a moment, then parted his lips.
findings.source: 귀찮아 죽겠다는 얼굴. 퉁명스러움이 뚝뚝 묻어 나오는 중년의 종업원을 물끄러미 바라보던 손님이 입술을 달싹인 것은 그때였다.

findings.current: It lasted less than fifteen minutes, so it’s hard to say.
findings.defect: Makes the Emperor’s symptoms seem to have lasted less than fifteen minutes.
findings.rationale: Hong Jin is explaining why he cannot describe symptoms he observed during a brief audience, not giving their duration.
findings.replacement: I saw him for less than fifteen minutes, so it’s hard to say.
findings.source: 일각도 되지 않을 만큼 짧아서 뭐라 말하기 힘들어요.

findings.current: Family ties and all that aside, the Emperor had seized the throne after practically bathing in the blood of his own relatives.
findings.defect: Softens the narrator’s dismissive rejection of familial affection.
findings.rationale: 나발이고 is contemptuous dismissal, not a neutral transition.
findings.replacement: To hell with family ties—the Emperor had seized the throne after practically bathing in his relatives’ blood.
findings.source: 피붙이 간의 정이고 나발이고, 일가친척의 피로 반신욕을 하다시피 하며 권좌를 탈취한 황제다.

findings.current: Those who’d signed a petition—a literal sheet passed around for signatures—already had an excellent alternative in Prince Shangshan.
findings.defect: Replaces the narrator’s anachronistic rolling-paper joke with a literal explanation.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly likens the petition to a 롤링페이퍼, a communal message sheet, for comic effect.
findings.replacement: The people who’d put together that petition—basically a rolling paper for signatures—already had an excellent alternative in Prince Shangshan.
findings.source: 당장 연판장(連判狀)이라는 이름의 롤링페이퍼를 작성한 이들에게는 상산왕이라는 훌륭한 대안이 있었으니까.

findings.current: They weren’t the neighbors next door, all gathering at Chunshik’s house to live happily ever after in Qianqing Palace.
findings.defect: Treats Chunshik’s house as a separate gathering place and adds a fairy-tale ending.
findings.rationale: Chunshik’s family next door is the ordinary household being contrasted with the imperial family; 오순도순 describes harmonious living, not a happy ending.
findings.replacement: These were members of the imperial family, not Chunshik’s family next door. Why would they all gather in Qianqing Palace and live together like one big happy family?
findings.source: 명색이 황족씩이나 되는 인간들이 옆집 춘식이네도 아닌데 건청궁에 모여 다 함께 오순도순 사는 게 말이 되나.

findings.current: The air in the hall was heavy and cold, as if everyone were thinking the same thing I was.
findings.defect: Uses “hall” where the chapter’s established rendering of 전각 is “pavilion.”
findings.rationale: The supplied glossary specifies “pavilion” for 전각 unless “hall” is established for a named building.
findings.replacement: The air in the pavilion was heavy and cold, as if everyone were thinking the same thing I was.
findings.source: 모두가 나와 같은 생각을 하는 듯, 전각 안의 공기는 무겁고 냉랭했다.

findings.current: He was old by then, though he was healthy enough to have an heir at that age.
findings.defect: Makes fathering a child sound like merely having an heir.
findings.rationale: 후사를 보셨을 만큼 정정하셨던 identifies his ability to father a child late in life as evidence of his former vigor.
findings.replacement: He was already old, though he’d been healthy enough to father a child at that age.
findings.source: 그 나이에 후사(後嗣)를 보셨을 만큼 정정하셨던 건 사실이지만 이미 연로하셨고.

findings.current: Hyuk Mujin, who’d been listening with wide eyes and a dry throat, stared at me. I nodded quietly.
findings.defect: Loses Mujin’s swallow and changes his sudden widening of the eyes into an ongoing expression.
findings.rationale: The source gives two distinct physical actions: swallowing and then opening his eyes wide.
findings.replacement: Hyuk Mujin, who’d been listening with a dry swallow, widened his eyes. I nodded quietly.
findings.source: 마른침을 삼키며 듣고 있던 혁무진이 눈을 부릅떴고, 나는 조용히 고개를 끄덕였다.

summary: The draft has a consequential reversed negation, a misidentified duration, and several smaller losses of action, humor, and register.
